subject: Request: Security & Compliance Package for Finnode RFP
messages:
From: Alice Chen <alice.chen@finnode.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Cc: security-team@finnode.com
Date: 2026-11-28T09:15:00-08:00
Subject: RFP: security/compliance package for Redwood - FINNODE

Hi Soojin,

Thanks for taking our call today. As part of Finnode's vendor selection for our payments platform, we'd like a packaged set of security and compliance artifacts to include in our RFP response. At minimum we need:

- SOC 2 report (most recent) and SOC 2 scope
- ISO 27001 certification statement or scope
- SIG control mapping (we use the Consensus SIG format) showing how Redwood maps controls to evidence
- Representative evidence files for a subset of controls (e.g., access logs, network diagram, MFA configuration screenshots)
- Answers to a short questionnaire (we'll send the questions below)

Can you confirm a delivery timeline and whether you require an NDA or a secure share before we exchange sample logs? We are on a tight procurement deadline (contract due week of 2026-12-07).

Sample questionnaire (short):
1) What is Redwood's SOC 2 scope (services, regions, retention)?
2) How do you isolate customer data in Dedicated and Private deployments?
3) Where are audit logs retained and for how long?

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick call if that helps.

Best,
Alice Chen
Head of Vendor Risk, Finnode
alice.chen@finnode.com

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Chen <alice.chen@finnode.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-28T11:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: RFP: security/compliance package for Redwood - FINNODE

Alice —

Thanks for the clear list and timeline. We can provide an initial package of artifacts and a SIG control mapping within three business days. High level: SOC 2 (Type II) covering Hosted API and Redwood Console, ISO 27001 scope statement for our control plane, and a SIG XLSX mapping for the most commonly requested control families.

Proposed next steps:
- We’ll share a secure Drive folder (link below) with redacted sample artifacts.
- If you need unredacted access logs, we request an executed NDA or a short sharing agreement — we can send our standard vendor NDA and a limited-access transfer method.
- We propose a 30-minute walkthrough on Friday (2026-12-01) to go over mapping and any follow-ups.

Attachments: artifact_index.csv (stub) — internal inventory of what we plan to upload.

If that works, I’ll kick off the internal evidence pull and loop in Marissa and Karthik to assemble the SIG mapping and SOC artifacts.

Cheers,
Soojin Lee
Director, Compliance & Trust
Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.ai

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-28T11:12:00-08:00
Subject: Fwd: RFP: security/compliance package for Finnode - action items

Team — forwarding Finnode's ask (see original below). Quick assignments: 

- Marissa: please pull the latest SOC 2 Type II report PDF and the SOC scope document. Redact client names as needed. Deliver to the secure folder and flag any PII that needs redaction.
- Karthik: assemble the SIG mapping spreadsheet covering at least the core control areas (Access Control, System Ops, Encryption, Change Mgmt). Mark evidence pointers (e.g., artifact filenames or Drive paths).
- Hannah: generate the updated network architecture diagram (private infra + hosted regions) and a short blurb on log retention policies.
- Jonas: export a short sample of access logs (last 7 days) with IPs redacted; if redaction is not feasible, provide a sanitized sample and the retention policy doc.

We have a 3-business-day window; target to populate the Drive folder by end of day 2026-11-30. If you hit blockers (e.g., legal redaction constraints, missing artifacts), call me immediately.

Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB2cDefGhIjKlMnOpQrSTuv

Thanks — Soojin

Drive link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB2cDefGhIjKlMnOpQrSTuv

- If Finnode requires deeper log history or raw unredacted logs, please confirm NDA first and we’ll coordinate with Legal and Ops.
- Karthik will join the walkthrough on 2026-12-01 to review the SIG mapping.

If you need anything else ahead of procurement, reply here and we’ll prioritize.

Best,
